_comment: Curated alarm-name -> citation registry read by scripts/check_alarm_citations.py (#1959). Every CloudWatch alarm that has been in ALARM >72h must have an entry here (exact AlarmName key) naming the incident row or issue that explains it, or the /wrap gate flags it by name. Add an entry the same session a new long-red alarm is triaged; remove/replace one once the underlying issue closes AND the alarm has actually cleared live.

qa-paused-by-budget.note: budget-tier cutoff-1 band (incl. qa-paused-by-budget's own AI gates) was off 26 of the last 30 days; fires whenever a qa-smoke run overlaps a paused feature. Red continuously since 2026-07-18.

qa-smoke-warnings.note: WarnCount's honest daily floor is 4-11 against a >=1 threshold, so red carried no information (15 consecutive red nights). Reclassification fix merged 2026-08-02 but not yet deployed live as of this filing — the alarm clears once the deploy ships (cdk_deploy.sh / deploy_all).

ingest-auth-unhealthy-24h.note: Whoop OAuth 401, auth breaker latched since 2026-08-01 12:00Z. Needs Matthew's interactive re-auth (setup/setup_whoop_auth.py --backfill) — gate:owner, cannot be automated.

life-platform-ingestion-dlq-messages.note: ALARM since 2026-08-03T12:04:26Z (verified via describe-alarm-history) — the whoop-data-ingestion EventBridge events that failed every hour from 12:00Z onward (first a 502 on the token endpoint, then repeated 'genuine auth failure' 400s the pre-fix breaker classifier never recognized) land here. The alarm + its urgent SNS route ('life-platform-alerts') worked correctly the whole time — remediation-dispatcher logged 'dispatched urgent_alarm' at 12:04:59Z — this was never a missing-machinery gap. Messages clear once #2069's classifier/rotation fix is deployed AND the credential is interactively re-authorized (owner action, concurrent with this filing) restores clean hourly runs; until then they are an accounted-for, expected byproduct of the known root cause, not a separate incident.

life-platform-dlq-depth-warning.note: Same underlying cause and same message set as life-platform-ingestion-dlq-messages above (duplicate alarm on the identical AWS/SQS ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible metric/dimension, routed to the digest topic instead of urgent) — ALARM since 2026-08-03T12:04:56Z, confirmed fired correctly.
